events.title: Mini Golf Pop Up
events.description: Conveniently located in downtown Asheville, the pop up features a playful outdoor mini golf course alongside food from Asheville Brewing. Whether you’re planning a family outing, date night, or an afternoon with friends, Asheville Mini Golf Pop Up is the perfect reason to come downtown and have some fun!

events.title: Jamie Ager Rally featuring Members of the Steep Canyon Rangers!
events.description: Join U.S. Congressional candidate Jamie Ager for a free rally and concert at Asheville Yards on Tuesday, October 13. The event features members of the Steep Canyon Rangers, Jon Stickley, Amanda Anne Platt, Casey Driessen, Woody Platt & Shannon Whitworth, along with members of Fireside Collective, The Honeycutters and Town Mountain. events.title: Holiday Ice Rink
events.description: Whether you’re planning a family outing, a festive date night or a weekend adventure, we have something for everyone to enjoy including holiday-inspired craft cocktails and hot chocolate, festive photo ops, a weekly winter market and weekly theme nights. Don’t miss your chance to create unforgettable memories this holiday season. Admission to Asheville Yards is FREE to all non-skaters, all season long.
